prayerExcerpt.en-US: As we celebrate his merits, may we imitate the example of his charity.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Celebrando os seus méritos, imitemos o exemplo de sua caridade.

meta.face: A Gallo-Roman aristocrat and poet of about seventy, clean-shaven in the late-Roman manner, with a FINE-BONED, HEART-SHAPED face — a wide forehead and temples tapering to a small, delicate, rounded chin; a well-shaped, high-bridged patrician nose; large, mild, light hazel eyes with fine crow's-feet under thin, gracefully arched silver brows; a gentle, full-lipped mouth set in a slight, warm smile; short, thick white hair combed forward in a straight Roman fringe; a courteous, tender gaze.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; he was a Bordeaux-born senator and governor of Campania who gave away his wealth and became bishop of Nola, where he died about 77. The clean-shaven Roman aristocrat with a poet's gentle face is our choice; the bell and the chain are his attributes in medieval tradition.
